title: Concept: Symfony profiler toolbar disclosed
description: The Symfony profiler toolbar is present in the response, so the debug profiler is enabled on this deployment and its stored request profiles are likely reachable.
applicability: Responses rendered by a Symfony application.
risk: Profiler profiles record SQL, configuration values and request parameters, and are addressable by token; MEDIUM because the toolbar itself does not prove the profile store is reachable.
